id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_alumni_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nim character varying NOT NULL,
  angkatan integer NOT NULL,
  program_studi character varying NOT NULL,
  tahun_lulus integer NOT NULL,
  perusahaan character varying,
  jabatan character varying,
  linkedin character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  bidang_industri character varying,
  tahun_mulai_bekerja integer,
  status_karir character varying,
  CONSTRAINT mk_alumni_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_alumni_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_audit_logs_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint,
  action character varying NOT NULL,
  subject_type character varying,
  subject_id bigint,
  description character varying NOT NULL,
  old_data json,
  new_data json,
  created_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT mk_audit_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_audit_logs_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_badges_id_seq'::regclass),
  name character varying NOT NULL,
  slug character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  icon character varying NOT NULL,
  description text NOT NULL,
  criteria_type character varying NOT NULL,
  criteria_value integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  image character varying,
  CONSTRAINT mk_badges_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_bidang_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_bidang character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  jenis character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bidang'::character varying,
  CONSTRAINT mk_bidang_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_comment_forum_id_seq'::regclass),
  discussion_id bigint NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  isi_comment text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_comment_forum_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_comment_forum_discussion_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (discussion_id) REFERENCES public.mk_discussion(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_comment_forum_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_comments_id_seq'::regclass),
  thread_id bigint NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  parent_id bigint,
  konten text NOT NULL,
  is_best_answer boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  vote_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_comments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_comments_parent_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES public.mk_comments(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_comments_thread_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (thread_id) REFERENCES public.mk_threads(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_comments_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_dashboard_analitik_id_seq'::regclass),
  lecturer_id bigint,
  generated_by_user_id bigint,
  tanggal_generate timestamp without time zone NOT NULL,
  total_mahasiswa_aktif integer NOT NULL,
  total_alumni integer NOT NULL,
  total_kegiatan integer NOT NULL,
  total_pengumuman integer NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_dashboard_analitik_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_dashboard_analitik_generated_by_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (generated_by_user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_dashboard_analitik_lecturer_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (lecturer_id) REFERENCES public.lecturers(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_discussion_id_seq'::regclass),
  forum_id bigint NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  judul_discussion character varying NOT NULL,
  isi_discussion text NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_discussion_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_discussion_forum_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (forum_id) REFERENCES public.mk_forum_mahasiswa(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_discussion_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_dosen_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nip character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  program_studi character varying NOT NULL,
  bidang_keahlian character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_dosen_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_dosen_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_forum_mahasiswa_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_forum character varying NOT NULL,
  deskripsi text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_mahasiswa_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_forum_notifications_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  actor_id bigint NOT NULL,
  type character varying NOT NULL,
  thread_id bigint NOT NULL,
  comment_id bigint,
  message text NOT NULL,
  read_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_notifications_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_notifications_actor_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (actor_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_notifications_comment_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (comment_id) REFERENCES public.mk_comments(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_notifications_thread_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (thread_id) REFERENCES public.mk_threads(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_notifications_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_forum_reports_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  thread_id bigint NOT NULL,
  alasan text NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_reports_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_reports_thread_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (thread_id) REFERENCES public.mk_threads(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_forum_reports_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kategori_kegiatan_id_seq'::regclass),
  nama_kategori character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kategori_kegiatan_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  kategori_kegiatan_id bigint,
  bidang_id bigint,
  judul character varying NOT NULL,
  deskripsi text NOT NULL,
  tanggal_mulai date,
  tanggal_selesai date,
  lokasi character varying,
  banner character varying,
  anggaran numeric,
  penanggung_jawab character varying,
  target_peserta integer,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  jam_mulai time without time zone,
  jam_selesai time without time zone,
  ketua_pelaksana_id bigint,
  tahun integer,
  realisasi_tanggal_mulai date,
  realisasi_tanggal_selesai date,
  realisasi_lokasi character varying,
  realisasi_peserta integer,
  realisasi_anggaran numeric,
  catatan_pelaksanaan text,
  surat_proker character varying,
  surat_proker_original character varying,
  is_pelaksanaan_updated boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  rencana_id bigint,
  disetujui_oleh bigint,
  disetujui_at timestamp without time zone,
  catatan_penolakan text,
  dosen_pendamping_id bigint,
  dana_departemen numeric,
  kas_himpunan numeric,
  kas_bidang numeric,
  ruangan_id bigint,
  status_tinjauan character varying,
  dikirim_tinjau_at timestamp without time zone,

  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_ketua_pelaksana_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (ketua_pelaksana_id) REFERENCES public.students(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_bidang_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (bidang_id) REFERENCES public.mk_bidang(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_kategori_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kategori_kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kategori_kegiatan(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_rencana_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (rencana_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_disetujui_oleh_foreign FOREIGN KEY (disetujui_oleh) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_dosen_pendamping_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (dosen_pendamping_id) REFERENCES public.lecturers(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_attachments_id_seq'::regclass),
  kegiatan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  file_path character varying NOT NULL,
  file_name character varying NOT NULL,
  file_size integer NOT NULL,
  tipe character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_attachments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_attachments_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_bidang_id_seq'::regclass),

  bidang_id bigint NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_bidang_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_bidang_bidang_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (bidang_id) REFERENCES public.mk_bidang(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_bidang_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_kategori_id_seq'::regclass),
  kegiatan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  kategori_kegiatan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_kategori_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_kategori_kategori_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kategori_kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kategori_kegiatan(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_kategori_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_panitia_id_seq'::regclass),
  kegiatan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  student_id bigint NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  peran character varying,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_panitia_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_panitia_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_panitia_student_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES public.students(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kegiatan_peserta_id_seq'::regclass),
  kegiatan_id bigint NOT NULL,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  status_kehadiran character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'terdaftar'::character varying,
  registered_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kegiatan_peserta_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_peserta_kegiatan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (kegiatan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_kegiatan(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_kegiatan_peserta_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kemahasiswaan_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nama character varying NOT NULL,
  nim character varying NOT NULL,
  angkatan integer NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  tahun_lulus integer,
  profesi character varying,
  kontak character varying,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  CONSTRAINT mk_kemahasiswaan_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_kemahasiswaan_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_kepengurusan_id_seq'::regclass),

  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_mahasiswa_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint NOT NULL,
  nim character varying NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  angkatan integer NOT NULL,
  program_studi character varying NOT NULL,
  status character varying NOT NULL,
  dosen_wali_id bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,

  CONSTRAINT mk_mahasiswa_dosen_wali_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (dosen_wali_id) REFERENCES public.mk_dosen(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_mahasiswa_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

permission_id bigint NOT NULL,
  model_type character varying NOT NULL,
  model_id bigint NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT mk_model_has_permissions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (permission_id, model_type, model_id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_model_has_permissions_permission_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (permission_id) REFERENCES public.mk_permissions(id)

role_id bigint NOT NULL,
  model_type character varying NOT NULL,
  model_id bigint NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT mk_model_has_roles_pkey PRIMARY KEY (role_id, model_type, model_id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_model_has_roles_role_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (role_id) REFERENCES public.mk_roles(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_pengaduan_id_seq'::regclass),
  user_id bigint,
  kategori character varying NOT NULL,
  is_anonim boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  data_template jsonb,
  status character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'baru'::character varying,
  read_at timestamp without time zone,
  read_by bigint,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  jawaban text,
  answered_at timestamp without time zone,
  answered_by bigint,
  reopen_count smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0'::smallint,
  reopen_reason text,
  auto_close_at timestamp without time zone,

  deleted_at timestamp without time zone,
  pelapor_tersimpan_id bigint,
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_answered_by_foreign FOREIGN KEY (answered_by) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_closed_by_foreign FOREIGN KEY (closed_by) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_read_by_foreign FOREIGN KEY (read_by) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_user_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT mk_pengaduan_pelapor_tersimpan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (pelapor_tersimpan_id) REFERENCES public.users(id)

  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_pengaduan_delegasi_delegated_to_foreign FOREIGN KEY (delegated_to) REFERENCES public.users(id),
  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_pengaduan_delegasi_pengaduan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (pengaduan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_pengaduan(id)

  CONSTRAINT lg_mk_pengaduan_log_pengaduan_id_foreign FOREIGN KEY (pengaduan_id) REFERENCES public.mk_pengaduan(id)

id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('mk_pengumuman_id_seq'::regclass),
